name: BurnerBook
tagline: One kitchen. Every delivery brand. One tidy ticket rail.
positioning: BurnerBook is the operating system for owner-operators running delivery-only brands out of a single kitchen — menus, orders, and margins in one place.

hero.h1: Run four delivery brands from one line — without the tablet pile.
hero.sub: BurnerBook syncs your menus across DoorDash, Uber Eats, and Grubhub, funnels every order to one ticket rail, and shows you which virtual brand is actually making money.

features.title: One menu, every marketplace
features.description: Edit a price or swap a photo once and it pushes to all your apps in seconds. No more re-typing the same wings menu into four dashboards.

features.title: Kill the tablet wall
features.description: Orders from every platform land on a single ticket rail and print to one kitchen printer, sorted by fire time so your line never guesses which app it came from.

features.title: 86 it everywhere at once
features.description: Sold out of short rib? Tap once and it goes dark across every brand and every app instantly — before the next order slips through.

features.title: Spin up a new brand by Friday
features.description: Our launch kit builds the menu, logo, and marketplace listings for a new virtual concept in an afternoon, so you can test demand without a new lease.

features.title: Prep forecasts that hold up
features.description: BurnerBook reads last week's tickets and tomorrow's weather to tell your prep cook how many portions to pull. Less waste, fewer weeds.

features.title: Margin by brand, not just sales
features.description: See true profit per brand after commissions, packaging, and labor — so you cut the concept that looks busy but bleeds cash.

testimonials.quote: We were running three brands off two iPads taped to the hood. Now every order hits one rail and my line cooks stopped cursing at me during the dinner rush.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The margin-by-brand report showed our 'famous' birria brand was actually our worst earner after fees. We killed it, doubled down on smash burgers, and rent got easy again.
testimonials.name: Devon Achebe

testimonials.quote: Launching a new brand used to eat my whole weekend. With BurnerBook I built a wings concept Thursday and took its first order Saturday. That still feels illegal.
testimonials.name: Priya Nandakumar

pricing.blurb: For a single kitchen testing one or two delivery brands.
For owner-operators juggling a full stack of brands from one address.

homepage.footerBlurb: BurnerBook helps independent kitchen operators run delivery-only brands like grown-up restaurants — organized, profitable, and off the tablet wall.
